Q1. Which area should this change target?
Choices:
A. AI issue-to-PR pipeline behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Documentation / onboarding
C. Review/autofix reliability
D. Other — specify the exact file, workflow, or feature
Q2. What kind of improvement is expected?
Choices:
A. Fix a specific bug or failure mode (RECOMMENDED)
B. Improve usability or clarity
C. Improve performance / cost / runtime
D. Add a new capability
Q3. What should count as success?
Choices:
A. A specific failing scenario now passes (RECOMMENDED)
B. A documented workflow becomes clearer
C. A measurable runtime/cost/reliability metric improves
D. Other — provide concrete acceptance criteria
